history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop plans for the production of monthly management accounts and improved financial reports to management, drawing on the opportunities being provided by IPSAS and the new enterprise resource planning system.
history.administration_response: The Administration informs that it has taken another major step towards the production of monthly management accounts and improved financial reports to management by developing an automated process for the production of the financial statements. In the meantime, the Administration continues to provide regular financial management updates to the Management Committee, supported by improved reporting via the Umoja business intelligence module. The Administration plans to introduce in 2018 more frequent reporting to senior managers and is currently exploring the scope of the management accounts and the level of detail to be included in the reporting package. Considerations that could affect monthly management accounts preparation are year-end accruals and adjusting entries, actuarially determined liabilities, and other year-end specific tasks and the extent of bringing such information into more frequent management accounts and eventually monthly accounts.
history.board_assessment: The Board noted the Administration’s response. However, the Board has yet to see the production of monthly management accounts. This recommendation is therefore considered under implementation.
